page.layout: One page of text: page number top left; running heading "EMBLEMA" with title "FORTVNA MODERATE" and subtitle "utendum" at full width above; a woodcut engraving in the centre; a four-line verse below the picture, centred; a catchword-like signature "Lusus" at the lower right.

main_text.head: EMBLEMA FORTVNA MODERATE utendum
main_text.p: [Woodcut engraving: winged figure standing on a globe over a hourglass, with a landscape below; not text.]
main_text.l: Ecce, instar globuli Fortuna volubilis errat;
Et facili motu voluitur, atq; ruit:
Sic Honor Orbis Abit, sic transit gloria mundi;

page.notes: The engraving is a figure of Fortuna winged, holding a rudder-like staff, standing on a globe with an hourglass beneath her feet. The word "Lusus" at the lower right is a printed signature-like mark, placed outside the verse. The subtitle "utendum" is underlined in the print, as are "Palma" and "Humilitas" in the verse.
